_README: Ingestion intake plan, ordered by how many benchmark questions each instrument carries. Derived from data/gold/bank_qa_data.csv via regrag/corpus/qa_loader.py on 2026-09-09. scripts/build_corpus_chunks.py reads this file; it fails loudly on any entry whose status is not 'skipped' but whose file is absent, so a partial delivery can never silently produce an empty corpus. Delivery convention: put the file at data/raw_legal/<expected_file>, set status to 'downloaded', then run the script.

_priority_summary.critical_warning: 3 of the top 5 are the unreachable sources: 32/2024/QH15 (luatvietnam, likely PARTIAL - 10 q), 22/2023/TT-NHNN (HTTP 404 - 10 q), 21/2021/NĐ-CP (HTTP 403 - 10 q). 30 of the top 51 questions depend on files that need a replacement source tonight. Download these three FIRST.
_priority_summary.unresolved_rows: 7 questions still map to UNRESOLVED:manifest-pending (5 opaque URLs). Their doc_id must be read off the downloaded file header and added to DOC_MANIFEST.json.
_priority_summary.distractors_are_valuable: 18/2024/TT-NHNN is already ingested and cited by ZERO questions. Keep it. A corpus containing only gold passages makes retrieval trivially perfect and cannot separate BM25 from dense; uncited instruments are what make Recall@k meaningful. Add more non-cited instruments if time allows.

documents.quarantine_reason: NOT AN AUTHENTIC LEGAL TEXT - audited 2026-09-09. The file is 3,611 chars / 43 lines and contains only Điều 1, 2, 3, 9, 14, 15, 23. Real instruments number articles contiguously; gaps of 3->9->14->23 cannot occur in a genuine circular. Only Chương I and II are present yet Điều 23 appears. The mandatory structural elements of every Vietnamese circular are all absent: no 'Căn cứ...' recitals, no effective-date clause, no 'Điều khoản thi hành' chapter, no signature block. The file ends mid-provision. It is cited by ZERO benchmark questions and was not sourced from the QA set.
documents.action_required: Do NOT ingest and do NOT keep as a distractor. Fabricated provisions in the corpus are worse than no distractor at all: a model could retrieve a fake article and be scored against it, contaminating every retrieval and hallucination number. The 22 chunks currently in data/processed_chunks/corpus_chunks.json all come from this file and must be treated as invalid. If a distractor is wanted, download a REAL uncited instrument (the genuine TT 18/2024/TT-NHNN from congbao.chinhphu.vn would work).
documents.note: Supersedes the earlier assumption that this was a usable seed corpus. The parser was validated against this text, which means its segmentation was tested on content whose formatting may have been generated to match the parser's own regexes - circular validation. Re-validate the parser against the real downloaded instruments.
